question: How many annual leave days do employees receive?
expectedAnswer: Employees receive 20 annual leave days per calendar year.

question: How many leave days can be carried forward?
expectedAnswer: Employees can carry forward up to 5 unused leave days to the next calendar year.
acceptableAnswers: Up to 5 unused leave days can be carried forward.

question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
expectedAnswer: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week, subject to approval.
acceptableAnswers: Employees can work remotely up to 3 days per week.
